description.value:
As long as you're not wearing heavy armor or carrying a medium or heavy shield, you gain the following benefits.

  • Your unarmed strikes and natural weapons deal damage one die size larger than normal (a flat 1 becomes a d4, a d4 becomes a d6, a d6 becomes a d8), and you can apply Sneak Attack to an unarmed strike even though it lacks the finesse property.
  • You no longer need advantage on the attack roll to apply Sneak Attack when your target is a creature you're grappling; every other rule for Sneak Attack still applies.
  • You can spend the bonus action from your Cunning Action to make an unarmed strike against a creature you're grappling.
